muhuratDisclaimer: This follows general Panchang-shuddhi rules found in muhurta texts and popular panchangs. Lists of favourable days differ between traditions, and important ceremonies are often fixed together with a family priest or astrologer.
muhuratAvoidKharmasInfo: When the Sun is in sidereal Sagittarius or Pisces (about mid-December to mid-January and mid-March to mid-April), many traditions pause weddings and similar ceremonies.
muhuratAvoidCombustInfo: When Jupiter or Venus is too close to the Sun (combust), they are traditionally considered too weak for weddings and house-warming.
muhuratAvoidChaturmasInfo: From Devshayani to Prabodhini Ekadashi, North Indian practice usually avoids weddings and house-warming. Many South Indian traditions do not follow this.
